sources.title: Daemon mode (qwen serve)

sources.finding: Experimental HTTP+SSE daemon with Web Shell, multiple workspaces, reconnect-safe streaming, first-responder permissions, remote runtime control and daemon-managed channels; loopback unauthenticated by default, token required beyond loopback; HTTPS guidance for phone access.

sources.title: Desktop shell README
sources.finding: Tauri 2 shell around the Web Shell starting qwen serve on loopback with a per-launch token; Local Control shares the daemon with a phone on the same Wi-Fi via QR code.

sources.title: VS Code integration
sources.finding: VS Code extension (Beta) with sidebar panel showing Qwen changes in real time with native diffs; Zed and JetBrains integrations documented separately.

sources.title: Subagents
sources.finding: Specialized subagents with own context and tools, foreground or background, with completion notifications.

sources.title: Multi-agent coordination
sources.locator: Enable Agent Team; Run a coordinated task
sources.finding: Experimental Agent Team: leader creates a team of up to three workstreams sharing a task list and messages, visible in Agent View tabs; enabled by experimental.agentTeam or QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1.

sources.title: Agent Arena
sources.finding: Experimental: run the same task with multiple models in isolated Git worktrees, compare side by side and pick the winner.

sources.title: Agent Board
sources.finding: Experimental file-based task board shared by independently started agents on one machine with qwen board commands; owner is only a recorded label.

sources.title: Goals
sources.finding: /goal keeps the session working until an independent verifier accepts the outcome within a token budget.

sources.title: Scheduled tasks
sources.locator: Session-scoped /loop and cron tools; Web Shell tasks
sources.finding: /loop and cron tools re-run prompts on intervals; terminal tasks are session-scoped; Web Shell Scheduled Tasks page and channel loops persist; experimental.cron enabled by default.

sources.title: Worktrees
sources.finding: qwen --worktree runs a session in an isolated Git worktree; mid-session worktree support.

sources.title: Sandbox
sources.finding: Linux bubblewrap tool-execution sandbox plus whole-CLI sandbox methods (Docker, Podman, macOS Seatbelt).

sources.title: Approval modes
sources.locator: Plan, default, auto-edit, auto mode, yolo
sources.finding: Plan mode and approval modes including classifier-driven Auto Mode and yolo.

sources.title: Memory
sources.finding: Agent-written auto-memory recalled across sessions plus QWEN.md and AGENTS.md briefings.

sources.title: Skills
sources.finding: Built-in skills (/review, /batch, /bugfix), /learn, auto-skills (opt-in) and /curator.

sources.title: Hooks
sources.finding: Hooks run user scripts before/after tool calls and at session lifecycle events.

sources.title: MCP
sources.finding: MCP client for tools, resources and prompts.

sources.title: Session management
sources.finding: Sessions can be resumed, browsed, renamed and archived; persisted transcripts.

sources.title: Code review
sources.finding: Built-in /review skill reviews code changes.

sources.title: Autofix a pull request
sources.finding: /autofix-pr watches a PR from a local session and fixes failed CI, trusted review feedback and merge conflicts in a worktree, with --once or --every scheduling.

sources.title: Channels
sources.finding: Telegram, WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, email, GitHub and GitLab channels drive an ACP agent process; scheduled channel loops; webhook delivery.

sources.title: Agent Team task types
sources.locator: types.ts lines 123-126 (blocks, blockedBy); TeamManager.ts line 2178; task-update.ts mirrors blocks into blockedBy
sources.finding: Team tasks carry blocks and blockedBy lists; update logic mirrors A.blocks=[B] into B.blockedBy=[A] and the manager skips tasks that still have blockers when picking pending work; no code propagates status to parents.

sources.title: Stats command and cost calculator
sources.finding: /stats prints session model, per-model and auth-type token and request totals and an optional cost computed from configured per-million-token prices; cost is N/A when no price is configured.

sources.title: Child environment sanitization
sources.locator: sanitize-child-env.ts used at shellExecutionService.ts lines 1013 and 2003
sources.finding: Strips Qwen-internal credentials and private parent capability variables from the environment passed to shell child processes.

sources.title: Session pull request binding
sources.finding: Daemon persists a GitHub pull request binding for a session when a PR is created from the session (for example from the Web Shell Git dialog).

sources.title: Chat compression
sources.locator: chatCompressionService.ts; cli commands compressCommand.ts, restoreCommand.ts, rewindCommand.ts
sources.finding: Conversation history is compressed automatically or with /compress; /restore and /rewind commands exist to return to earlier state.

sources.title: Session writer lease
sources.finding: A writer lease prevents two processes from writing the same session concurrently.

sources.title: Channels overview (access policy)
sources.locator: privatePolicy and sender policy; shared-session operator privileges
sources.finding: Managed channels default to pairing access; allowlist and open policies exist; in shared sessions, session management such as /approve-always and cancel requires operator privileges.

sources.title: Scheduled tasks behavior notes
sources.finding: A task whose time passes while Qwen Code is busy fires once when idle, not once per missed interval; gates must finish in the foreground.

sources.title: Chat recording service
sources.finding: Sessions are recorded as append-only JSONL files with system records that can alter how history is reconstructed; files are plain local files.
